meta.title: Model Gateway
meta.description: One plugin for every points-for-models platform: WorkBuddy, CodeArts, Meoo, SCNet, WPS Lingxi and SenseTime Raccoon. Shared login and account pool, balances, model catalog and switches, auto check-in; enabled models appear in the DSH model picker. Auto mode falls back along a platform + account + model priority chain when a candidate is rate-limited, out of quota, or signed out.

gateway.name: OpenAI Gateway
gateway.accessHint: Copy these into any OpenAI-compatible client to call models in 魔桥.
gateway.listenHint: Loopback only by default; switch to a LAN IP for internal use. Changes restart the listener.
gateway.tlsHint: Not implemented — LAN plaintext only; keys could be sniffed on the same subnet
gateway.auditHint: Records time/key suffix/model/account/tokens, never message bodies
gateway.accessKeysHint: One key per agent recommended. Full key is shown only once at creation; only hashes are stored.
gateway.secretOnce: Created — copy it now; the full value cannot be viewed again after closing
gateway.aliasesHint: mg-provider:model works directly; aliases give agents a stable short name.
gateway.warning: ⚠ These six platforms are private APIs billed to your own accounts; for personal research only, no commercial use.
gateway.modelsHint: One alias per model: type in the row and press Enter; click × to remove and set another.
gateway.noModels: No models enabled yet. Tick some in the platform tabs first.
gateway.updateNoChanges: Could not fetch release notes (GitHub API unreachable)
gateway.updateCommand: Run this in a terminal to update
gateway.updateHint: This phase only notifies: updating replaces plugin files, so installing it yourself is safer.
